links.outcome: Head-to-head sensitivity and specificity of two ICH triage AI vendors on same local CT scans
links.effect: Vendor A sensitivity 94.4%, specificity 97.4%; Vendor B sensitivity 59.5%, specificity 99.0%. Vendor A had 20 FNs and 97 FPs; Vendor B had 145 FNs and 36 FPs.
links.quote: Vendor A demonstrated a sensitivity of 94.4% and specificity of 97.4%, PPV of 77.7%, and NPV of 99.5%.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of two commercially available AI triage software tools (Aidoc vs. Viz.ai) on a large cohort of noncontrast head CT scans, evaluating diagnostic accuracy without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
